feature_title: Dashboard Chart Zoom Brush & Panel Drag

rationale.edition: All four changed paths sit under tests/ui-testing/ (ci-matrix/ci_matrix.json, pages/dashboardPages/dashboard-zoom-drag.js, pages/page-manager.js, playwright-tests/Dashboards/dashboard-zoom-brush.spec.js). None are in enterprise-owned locations (no enterprise/, o2_enterprise/, or src/enterprise/ paths) and no enterprise keywords (SSO/SAML/RBAC/SDR/logo-management) appear in the paths or symbols, so this is an OSS change.
rationale.skip: Not skipped. The trigger comment and feature hint are empty (no tests-added label or explicit skip request), and although the diff is test-only (no web/src or backend change), it adds a new Playwright E2E spec. Dev-authored E2E tests are not an automatic skip — the Architect reviews them in enhance mode.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted. The new spec exercises user-facing dashboard interactions — ECharts dataZoom brush-to-zoom switching the dashboard to an absolute time range, GridStack panel drag/reposition persisting the layout, selection-tint appearance, and drag cancel-vs-handle behavior. These are real UI flows the dev's coverage targets, so they should be reviewed and possibly extended rather than ignored.
rationale.area: Dashboards — the spec lives at tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Dashboards/dashboard-zoom-brush.spec.js and tests dashboard chart zoom and panel drag, matching the Dashboards area (the matrix group's actual_folder is Dashboards).
rationale.group: Dashboards-Charts — the diff appends dashboard-zoom-brush.spec.js to the ci_matrix group whose run_files already list dashboard-sankey, dashboard-pie-donut, dashboard-metric-camelcase and dashboard-create-alert, which corresponds to the Dashboards-Charts testfolder.
rationale.existing_tests: Yes — the diff adds a Playwright E2E spec (tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Dashboards/dashboard-zoom-brush.spec.js, 6 test cases) covering the zoom-brush and panel-drag behavior, plus its page object and a page-manager registration. No Vitest/unit (web/src/**/*.spec.ts) or Rust tests are involved, so this counts as E2E spec coverage in the diff.
